body:
Source: GitHub issue #1019 (bug). Re-verified against main @ b4cff43c plus the #1023 harness fix. The apply path lets the groomed set or the working copy decide the terms of a write in seven places.

1. APPROVAL NOT BOUND TO CONTENT. `lib/gate.mjs` `gateKey`/`ledgerApproves` bind an approval to (number, action, field, contentHash) only. A later action on the same key with a different relabel `to`/`from` or different `evidence` executes on the earlier approval (`lib/execute.mjs` `planAction` consults only `ledgerApproves`).
2. FREE-FORM FIELD. `proposals[].field` is never validated (`lib/apply.mjs` `revalidateAction`) but is part of the one-shot key (`gate.mjs:98`), so `priority`, `Priority`, `priority ` are three keys and three reviews for one relabel.
3. AREA TARGET NOT DERIVED, SOURCE OPTIONAL. `revalidateAction` accepts any declared area label as a relabel target regardless of where the issue's verified locations sit, accepts a priority field carrying an area label and vice versa, and accepts a relabel with no `from` (add-label only, stacking a second label).
4. MARKER INJECTION. `renderComment` (`execute.mjs`) embeds `evidence` verbatim; evidence containing another action's marker for the same issue and revision makes that action find "its own" marker once the first comment is posted, and it acts with no evidence comment.
5. CALLER-CHOSEN PROFILE PATH. `bin/backlog-groom.mjs:82` accepts `--profile` on `--apply`, and `baseProfileFromGit(profilePath)` reads the merge-base baseline at that same path. A path absent at the base yields the permissive default baseline, so the committed profile's frozenPaths stop binding (reproduced: a relabel on a frozen-path issue was commented and edited).
6. WORKING-COPY POLICY. `providers`, `labels` and `units` are read only from the working copy. They decide the reviewer (`adversarial-review --provider <reviewer>` accepts any local command) and the sanctioned relabel targets.
7. STALE-LOCK TAKEOVER. `lib/io.mjs` `acquireApplyLock` renames whatever lock is at the path after deciding the one it examined was stale; if another recoverer retook the lock in between, the live lock is moved and cleared and both runs hold it.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/backlog-groom`: `bin/backlog-groom.mjs` (the `--apply` branch wires lock, ledger, base profile, reviewer, writer), `lib/apply.mjs` (`actionsFromSet`, `revalidateAction`, `applyRun`), `lib/execute.mjs` (`executeActions`, `renderComment`, `marker`), `lib/gate.mjs` (`gateAction`, `gateKey`, `ledgerApproves`, `buildActionArtifact`), `lib/floor.mjs` (floor and frozen-path validators), `lib/io.mjs` (`baseProfileFromGit`, ledger, lock), `lib/usage.mjs` (`validateApplyArgs`), `lib/cluster.mjs` (`unitsForIssue`, `globMatch`), `lib/verify.mjs` (`verifyIssue`). Tests: `npm test -w packages/backlog-groom`. The failing tests for all seven are in `test/write-boundary.test.mjs` and `test/apply-e2e.test.mjs` ("--profile is refused on --apply…").

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. `gateAction` records `artifactDigest` = sha256 hex of `buildActionArtifact(action)` in the ledger entry, and `ledgerApproves` additionally requires `entry.artifactDigest === digest(action)`. An entry without a digest does not approve. The one-shot key is unchanged.
2. `revalidateAction` for a relabel: `field` must be exactly `priority` or `area`; `from` is required; `from !== to`. Priority: `to` and `from` must both be values of the profile's `labels.priority`. Area: `to` and `from` must both start with `labels.areaPrefix` and name declared units, the recomputed verdict must be `valid` or `fixed`, `unitsForIssue(recomputed, classified, units)` must be exactly one unit, and `to` must equal `areaPrefix + that unit`. `from` must be on the freshly fetched issue (unchanged).
3. `renderComment` neutralises every `<!--` in the evidence (rendered as `<!--`), so only the marker the tool appends can match the resume check.
4. `validateApplyArgs` returns an error when `--profile` accompanies `--apply`; the apply path reads `.claude/backlog-groom-profile.json` only.
5. A single validator `assertPolicyUnchanged({ base, head })` in `lib/floor.mjs` throws an operational error naming the key when `providers`, `labels` or `units` differ (canonical JSON comparison) between the merge-base profile and the working copy, and throws when `base` is not an object. `applyRun` takes a required `basePolicy` and calls it before any review. `baseProfileFromGit` returns the fully parsed default profile (not just floor and frozenPaths) when the profile is absent at the base; the bin passes the base profile as `basePolicy`.
6. `acquireApplyLock` records what it judged stale (the raw owner text, or for an owner-less lock its inode and mtime), and after renaming verifies the claimed directory is that same lock; if not, it renames the claimed directory back and throws an operational error without taking the lock.
7. Documentation: add the base-policy rule and the `--profile` refusal after the floor-widening paragraph in `docs/tools/backlog-groom.md` and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/backlog-groom.mdx` (same text), to the floor bullet in `.claude/skills/backlog-groom/SKILL.md`, and to the Profile section of `packages/backlog-groom/README.md`.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 An approval does not license a different target or different evidence; the approved action still executes. verify: `node --test packages/backlog-groom/test/write-boundary.test.mjs`
- AC2 A non-canonical field, a cross-class label, a missing source and an underived area target are refused; a derived area relabel is accepted; re-spelling the field buys no second review. verify: `node --test packages/backlog-groom/test/write-boundary.test.mjs`
- AC3 Evidence carrying another action's marker does not suppress that action's comment. verify: `node --test packages/backlog-groom/test/write-boundary.test.mjs`
- AC4 Working-copy providers, labels or units that differ from the base refuse the run before any review; an unknown base refuses; a matching base proceeds. verify: `node --test packages/backlog-groom/test/write-boundary.test.mjs`
- AC5 A recoverer that loses the stale-lock race throws and leaves the winner's lock in place; uncontested stale and expired locks are still recovered. verify: `node --test packages/backlog-groom/test/write-boundary.test.mjs`
- AC6 `--profile` with `--apply` exits 1 with no writes, and the control run under the committed profile writes nothing to a frozen issue. verify: `node --test packages/backlog-groom/test/apply-e2e.test.mjs`
- AC7 Existing suite green (tests that pinned the old relabel acceptance are rewritten to derived relabels). verify: `npm test -w packages/backlog-groom`
- AC8 Docs updated in all four places. verify: `grep -c "merge base" docs/tools/backlog-groom.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/backlog-groom.mdx .claude/skills/backlog-groom/SKILL.md packages/backlog-groom/README.md` (each >= 1)
- AC9 Mutation gate green. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also `--max 80` locally)

OUT OF SCOPE: integrity of the ledger file itself (deleting or hand-writing it); reading the base from the remote default branch instead of local refs; binding gh's target repository to the verified checkout; re-deriving priority relabel targets (a rank judgment); the unrendered `Reviewed by` line in `renderComment`.
title: backlog-groom: bind write authorization to what was reviewed and to the merge-base policy
